memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Atrial fibrillation: Status: stable on apixaban 5 mg BD and bisoprolol 2.5 OD, no recent palpitations. Plan: continue apixaban, bisoprolol; check INR if warfarin considered later.
- Benign positional vertigo: Status: reports occasional brief spinning on lying down, no falls. Plan: start betahistine 16 mg BD, keep meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute episodes.
- COPD: Status: dyspnea on exertion mMRC 1, uses tiotropium OD and salbutamol SOS. Plan: continue inhalers, check spirometry.
- Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (male cut-off 90 cm) – central obesity.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – idli with sambar, limited oil; Lunch – wheat roti, dal, vegetable curry, small rice portion; Dinner – light khichdi, curd.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose-lowering therapy).
